scope: Source-only review and bounded Git fixture corrections; production remains fail-closed
changes: n124Git now has a 20-second context deadline and one-second WaitDelay

blockers.detail: No git-canonical contract/parser or remote snapshot allocator exists. All Git new/close still reject. This is unfinished implementation, not a claim that Git CAS is impossible.

Current shared paths publish source node and spine before learning. Putting a remote lease around the existing calls still leaves source mutations on a losing publication. They must prepare immutable bytes without invoking these write paths.

Current intents are stored under RuntimeRoot and bound to absolute Product/RuntimeRoot. They contain no canonical ref, expected commit, accepted commit, or canonical request lookup. After remote acceptance and failed local readback, a fresh worktree cannot prove acceptance from these intents; a retry must not allocate another ID or replay unverified learning.

Disposable bare-origin push fails before protocol assertions: sh.exe could not create signal pipe, Win32 error 5. Native positive acceptance tests have not been implemented; running existing probes outside sandbox alone cannot establish acceptance.

required_protocol: Strict machine contract binds physical product/repository path, canonical remote identity, full branch ref and learning outbox version. Reject missing, foreign and unsupported configurations before any PLAN/LEARN write.
Read and verify remote preimage and matching source HEAD, exact PLAN/node blobs and numeric ID uniqueness. Derive N-121 from accepted canonical N-120, never a stale local directory.

Prepare node, spine and immutable request/event outbox in one new commit with the verified old commit as its parent, using a private index/object preparation path. Do not stage dirty WIP or edit source PLAN/LEARN.
Publish only that new canonical commit with explicit --force-with-lease=<ref>:<oldSHA>; verify parent ancestry so the proposed update is fast-forward. A separate claim is not acceptance.

On ambiguous push/readback failure, fetch canonical history and locate the exact durable request and payload digest. Matching accepted bytes recover the original node/event; reused request with different bytes is conflict. Missing/unreachable evidence stays pending and must not cause learning replay or new allocation.

Reconcile learning from the accepted outbox with stable event identity and verified payload. Preserve dirty local projection bytes on conflict and report remote acceptance separately from local reconciliation.

Before enabling the mode, exercise actual native new/close against temp bare Git: one winner from two stale clones, untouched losing WIP, N-121, original-blob close, config/path/HEAD rejection, collision rejection and post-push recovery.
